list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

FROM collect.v_database_config AS dc
WHERE dc.server_id IN (${server:csv})

list.description: Scopes the database configuration change history.

targets.rawSql:
WITH walked AS (
    SELECT
        sc.server_id,
        sc.capture_time,
        sc.configuration_name,
        sc.value_configured,
        sc.value_in_use,
        sc.is_dynamic,
        sc.is_advanced,
        LAG(sc.value_configured) OVER w AS prev_configured,
        LAG(sc.value_in_use) OVER w AS prev_in_use,
        LAG(sc.capture_time) OVER w AS prev_capture
    FROM collect.v_server_config AS sc
    WHERE sc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND sc.capture_time <= $__timeTo()
    WINDOW w AS (
        PARTITION BY sc.server_id, sc.configuration_name ORDER BY sc.capture_time
    )
)
SELECT
    w.capture_time AS "Change Time",
    srv.name AS "Server",
    w.configuration_name AS "Setting",
    w.prev_configured AS "Old Configured",
    w.value_configured AS "New Configured",
    w.prev_in_use AS "Old In Use",
    w.value_in_use AS "New In Use",
    CASE WHEN w.is_dynamic THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Dynamic",
    CASE WHEN w.is_advanced THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Advanced",
    /* The Dashboard view's own definition: a non-dynamic setting whose configured value
       differs from the in-use value is waiting on a restart. */
    CASE WHEN w.is_dynamic = FALSE AND w.value_configured IS DISTINCT FROM w.value_in_use
         THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Requires Restart",
    CASE
        WHEN w.prev_configured IS DISTINCT FROM w.value_configured
            THEN 'Configured value changed from ' || COALESCE(w.prev_configured::text, '')
                 || ' to ' || COALESCE(w.value_configured::text, '')
        WHEN w.prev_in_use IS DISTINCT FROM w.value_in_use
            THEN 'In-use value changed from ' || COALESCE(w.prev_in_use::text, '')
                 || ' to ' || COALESCE(w.value_in_use::text, '')
        ELSE 'Value unchanged'
    END AS "Change"
FROM walked AS w
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = w.server_id
WHERE w.prev_capture IS NOT NULL
  AND (w.prev_configured IS DISTINCT FROM w.value_configured
       OR w.prev_in_use IS DISTINCT FROM w.value_in_use)
  AND $__timeFilter(w.capture_time)
ORDER BY w.capture_time DESC, w.configuration_name

WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        dc.server_id,
        dc.capture_time,
        dc.database_name,
        LAG(dc.capture_time) OVER w AS prev_capture,
        dc.state_desc::text AS state_desc,
        LAG(dc.state_desc::text) OVER w AS prev_state_desc,
        dc.compatibility_level::text AS compatibility_level,
        LAG(dc.compatibility_level::text) OVER w AS prev_compatibility_level,
        dc.collation_name::text AS collation_name,
        LAG(dc.collation_name::text) OVER w AS prev_collation_name,
        dc.recovery_model::text AS recovery_model,
        LAG(dc.recovery_model::text) OVER w AS prev_recovery_model,
        dc.is_read_only::text AS is_read_only,
        LAG(dc.is_read_only::text) OVER w AS prev_is_read_only,
        dc.is_auto_close_on::text AS is_auto_close_on,
        LAG(dc.is_auto_close_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_auto_close_on,
        dc.is_auto_shrink_on::text AS is_auto_shrink_on,
        LAG(dc.is_auto_shrink_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_auto_shrink_on,
        dc.is_auto_create_stats_on::text AS is_auto_create_stats_on,
        LAG(dc.is_auto_create_stats_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_auto_create_stats_on,
        dc.is_auto_update_stats_on::text AS is_auto_update_stats_on,
        LAG(dc.is_auto_update_stats_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_auto_update_stats_on,
        dc.is_auto_update_stats_async_on::text AS is_auto_update_stats_async_on,
        LAG(dc.is_auto_update_stats_async_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_auto_update_stats_async_on,
        dc.is_read_committed_snapshot_on::text AS is_read_committed_snapshot_on,
        LAG(dc.is_read_committed_snapshot_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_read_committed_snapshot_on,
        dc.snapshot_isolation_state::text AS snapshot_isolation_state,
        LAG(dc.snapshot_isolation_state::text) OVER w AS prev_snapshot_isolation_state,
        dc.is_parameterization_forced::text AS is_parameterization_forced,
        LAG(dc.is_parameterization_forced::text) OVER w AS prev_is_parameterization_forced,
        dc.is_query_store_on::text AS is_query_store_on,
        LAG(dc.is_query_store_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_query_store_on,
        dc.is_encrypted::text AS is_encrypted,
        LAG(dc.is_encrypted::text) OVER w AS prev_is_encrypted,
        dc.is_trustworthy_on::text AS is_trustworthy_on,
        LAG(dc.is_trustworthy_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_trustworthy_on,
        dc.is_db_chaining_on::text AS is_db_chaining_on,
        LAG(dc.is_db_chaining_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_db_chaining_on,
        dc.is_broker_enabled::text AS is_broker_enabled,
        LAG(dc.is_broker_enabled::text) OVER w AS prev_is_broker_enabled,
        dc.is_cdc_enabled::text AS is_cdc_enabled,
        LAG(dc.is_cdc_enabled::text) OVER w AS prev_is_cdc_enabled,
        dc.is_mixed_page_allocation_on::text AS is_mixed_page_allocation_on,
        LAG(dc.is_mixed_page_allocation_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_mixed_page_allocation_on,
        dc.log_reuse_wait_desc::text AS log_reuse_wait_desc,
        LAG(dc.log_reuse_wait_desc::text) OVER w AS prev_log_reuse_wait_desc,
        dc.page_verify_option::text AS page_verify_option,
        LAG(dc.page_verify_option::text) OVER w AS prev_page_verify_option,
        dc.target_recovery_time_seconds::text AS target_recovery_time_seconds,
        LAG(dc.target_recovery_time_seconds::text) OVER w AS prev_target_recovery_time_seconds,
        dc.delayed_durability::text AS delayed_durability,
        LAG(dc.delayed_durability::text) OVER w AS prev_delayed_durability,
        dc.is_accelerated_database_recovery_on::text AS is_accelerated_database_recovery_on,
        LAG(dc.is_accelerated_database_recovery_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_accelerated_database_recovery_on,
        dc.is_memory_optimized_enabled::text AS is_memory_optimized_enabled,
        LAG(dc.is_memory_optimized_enabled::text) OVER w AS prev_is_memory_optimized_enabled,
        dc.is_optimized_locking_on::text AS is_optimized_locking_on,
        LAG(dc.is_optimized_locking_on::text) OVER w AS prev_is_optimized_locking_on
    FROM collect.v_database_config AS dc
    WHERE dc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND dc.capture_time <= $__timeTo()
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${database:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR dc.database_name = ANY(ARRAY[${database:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY dc.server_id, dc.database_name ORDER BY dc.capture_time)
),
walked AS (
    SELECT
        l.server_id,
        l.capture_time,
        l.database_name,
        l.prev_capture,
        s.setting_name,
        s.new_value,
        s.old_value
    FROM lagged AS l
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        ('state_desc', l.state_desc, l.prev_state_desc),
        ('compatibility_level', l.compatibility_level, l.prev_compatibility_level),
        ('collation_name', l.collation_name, l.prev_collation_name),
        ('recovery_model', l.recovery_model, l.prev_recovery_model),
        ('is_read_only', l.is_read_only, l.prev_is_read_only),
        ('is_auto_close_on', l.is_auto_close_on, l.prev_is_auto_close_on),
        ('is_auto_shrink_on', l.is_auto_shrink_on, l.prev_is_auto_shrink_on),
        ('is_auto_create_stats_on', l.is_auto_create_stats_on, l.prev_is_auto_create_stats_on),
        ('is_auto_update_stats_on', l.is_auto_update_stats_on, l.prev_is_auto_update_stats_on),
        ('is_auto_update_stats_async_on', l.is_auto_update_stats_async_on, l.prev_is_auto_update_stats_async_on),
        ('is_read_committed_snapshot_on', l.is_read_committed_snapshot_on, l.prev_is_read_committed_snapshot_on),
        ('snapshot_isolation_state', l.snapshot_isolation_state, l.prev_snapshot_isolation_state),
        ('is_parameterization_forced', l.is_parameterization_forced, l.prev_is_parameterization_forced),
        ('is_query_store_on', l.is_query_store_on, l.prev_is_query_store_on),
        ('is_encrypted', l.is_encrypted, l.prev_is_encrypted),
        ('is_trustworthy_on', l.is_trustworthy_on, l.prev_is_trustworthy_on),
        ('is_db_chaining_on', l.is_db_chaining_on, l.prev_is_db_chaining_on),
        ('is_broker_enabled', l.is_broker_enabled, l.prev_is_broker_enabled),
        ('is_cdc_enabled', l.is_cdc_enabled, l.prev_is_cdc_enabled),
        ('is_mixed_page_allocation_on', l.is_mixed_page_allocation_on, l.prev_is_mixed_page_allocation_on),
        ('log_reuse_wait_desc', l.log_reuse_wait_desc, l.prev_log_reuse_wait_desc),
        ('page_verify_option', l.page_verify_option, l.prev_page_verify_option),
        ('target_recovery_time_seconds', l.target_recovery_time_seconds, l.prev_target_recovery_time_seconds),
        ('delayed_durability', l.delayed_durability, l.prev_delayed_durability),
        ('is_accelerated_database_recovery_on', l.is_accelerated_database_recovery_on, l.prev_is_accelerated_database_recovery_on),
        ('is_memory_optimized_enabled', l.is_memory_optimized_enabled, l.prev_is_memory_optimized_enabled),
        ('is_optimized_locking_on', l.is_optimized_locking_on, l.prev_is_optimized_locking_on)
    ) AS s(setting_name, new_value, old_value)
)
SELECT
    w.capture_time AS "Change Time",
    srv.name AS "Server",
    w.database_name AS "Database",
    w.setting_name AS "Setting",
    w.old_value AS "Old Value",
    w.new_value AS "New Value",
    CASE
        WHEN w.old_value IS NULL AND w.new_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'Set to: ' || w.new_value
        WHEN w.old_value IS NOT NULL AND w.new_value IS NULL
            THEN 'Cleared (was: ' || w.old_value || ')'
        ELSE 'Changed from ' || COALESCE(w.old_value, '') || ' to '
             || COALESCE(w.new_value, '')
    END AS "Change"
FROM walked AS w
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = w.server_id
WHERE w.prev_capture IS NOT NULL
  AND w.old_value IS DISTINCT FROM w.new_value
  AND $__timeFilter(w.capture_time)
ORDER BY w.capture_time DESC, w.database_name, w.setting_name

WITH captures AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tf.server_id, tf.capture_time
    FROM collect.v_trace_flags AS tf
    WHERE tf.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND tf.capture_time <= $__timeTo()
),
paired AS (
    SELECT server_id, capture_time,
           LAG(capture_time) OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY capture_time)
               AS prev_capture
    FROM captures
),
flags AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tf.server_id, tf.trace_flag
    FROM collect.v_trace_flags AS tf
    WHERE tf.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND tf.capture_time <= $__timeTo()
),
diffed AS (
    SELECT
        p.server_id,
        p.capture_time,
        f.trace_flag,
        prv.status AS prev_status,
        cur.status AS new_status,
        COALESCE(cur.is_global, prv.is_global) AS is_global,
        COALESCE(cur.is_session, prv.is_session) AS is_session,
        CASE
            WHEN prv.trace_flag IS NULL THEN 'enabled'
            WHEN cur.trace_flag IS NULL THEN 'disabled'
            ELSE 'modified'
        END AS change_type
    FROM paired AS p
    JOIN flags AS f ON f.server_id = p.server_id
    LEFT JOIN collect.v_trace_flags AS cur
        ON cur.server_id = p.server_id
       AND cur.capture_time = p.capture_time
       AND cur.trace_flag = f.trace_flag
    LEFT JOIN collect.v_trace_flags AS prv
        ON prv.server_id = p.server_id
       AND prv.capture_time = p.prev_capture
       AND prv.trace_flag = f.trace_flag
    WHERE p.prev_capture IS NOT NULL
      /* Present in neither capture is not a change, it is a flag that exists elsewhere in
         the window; the two set-membership arms below are the enable/disable cases. */
      AND (cur.trace_flag IS NOT NULL OR prv.trace_flag IS NOT NULL)
      AND (prv.trace_flag IS NULL
           OR cur.trace_flag IS NULL
           OR prv.status IS DISTINCT FROM cur.status
           OR prv.is_global IS DISTINCT FROM cur.is_global
           OR prv.is_session IS DISTINCT FROM cur.is_session)
)
SELECT
    d.capture_time AS "Change Time",
    srv.name AS "Server",
    d.trace_flag AS "Trace Flag",
    d.change_type AS "Change Type",
    CASE WHEN d.prev_status IS NULL THEN '' WHEN d.prev_status THEN 'ON' ELSE 'OFF' END
        AS "Previous Status",
    CASE WHEN d.new_status IS NULL THEN '' WHEN d.new_status THEN 'ON' ELSE 'OFF' END
        AS "New Status",
    CASE WHEN d.is_global THEN 'GLOBAL' WHEN d.is_session THEN 'SESSION' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END
        AS "Scope",
    CASE d.change_type
        WHEN 'enabled' THEN 'Trace flag ' || d.trace_flag || ' ENABLED'
        WHEN 'disabled' THEN 'Trace flag ' || d.trace_flag || ' DISABLED'
        WHEN 'modified' THEN 'Trace flag ' || d.trace_flag || ' scope changed'
        ELSE 'Status unchanged'
    END AS "Change"
FROM diffed AS d
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = d.server_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.capture_time)
ORDER BY d.capture_time DESC, d.trace_flag
